ns2:section.sectionText: REGISTRATION IN THIS LECTURE REQUIRES SIMULTANEOUS REGISTRATION IN LAB AB1 OR AB2. Please note the stated prerequisites. If available, seats may open to sophomore majors on December 8. Watch the class schedule for updated information. Please note: This section will offer a mix of synchronous (live) and asynchronous (not live) sessions. Your instructor will be in contact with further details including information on course management systems.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Sophomore class standing.
